correctness.rationale: The exact squarefree-product series follows from the valid recurrence/convolution expansion. Weighted prime-sum estimates using PNT are explicitly derived with kernel integrals 1 and 0 and effective harmonic-prime error. They imply H_x(t sqrt x)=(2t(1-ln t)+o(1))sqrt x/ln x and derivative -2ln t/ln x. Strict concavity fixes a unique saddle at t→1; a geometric tail shows the sum has the same leading log as its largest term. Exact integer recursion and ordered-Bell polynomial checks agree for the first ten primorials; only the proof establishes the infinite claim.
